scientific_conclusion: No optical open-water signal was detected among the observed exploratory radar candidate pixels in the September 4 image.
limitations: Radar darkening does not uniquely indicate flooding.
The optical image is one day before the post-event radar image.
920 candidate pixels lack usable optical coverage.
Optical and radar pixels have different native resolutions.
Vegetation-covered or shallow flooding may be missed.
No independently verified flood reference labels are available.
website_warning: Not independently validated as flood extent.
